messages:
maria (oncall): Heads up — we're seeing a p99 latency spike on prod-api (region-us-west). p99 jumped ~3.5x over the last 6m. I opened a rollback PR that reverts the connpool change: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/9123. Can someone take a quick look/approve? :eyes:
aj: on it, linking the grafana panel so others can eyeball: https://grafana.company/internal/d/abc123/prod-api-latency
jordan: I'll grab this now and run the pre-checks. Any canary telemetry?
maria (oncall): Canary shows elevated latencies too, the canary hosts are at ~300ms p99 vs baseline 100ms. No errors spike, just tail latency. No rollout yet — traffic still on old pods.
sre-bot: Incident detected: latency_p99_threshold_exceeded (prod-api). Incident ID: INC-2026-324. Pager assigned: maria.
lee: If you need a quick approve for rollback we can do a hot rollback outside normal window, but want a quick post-rollback smoke run.
olga: tagging infra: @aj can you also check connpool config diff? Might be a config regression, not code.
aj: diff looks small — default conn max changed from 100 -> 50 in the new deploy. That could explain queuing at high concurrency. Will comment on the PR with the diff snippet.
jordan: Reviewing PR now... small revert, tests pass in CI, looks safe. I can approve and then coordinate the rollback deploy.
maria (oncall): Thanks. If you approve, I'll trigger the rollback deploy to prod-canary first and monitor for 5m.
jordan: Approved. LGTM. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: PR 9123 approved by jordan. Ready to merge.
aj: One extra thing — add a short note in the PR description about the follow-up config tweak we should try after rollback (increase conn max back but add backpressure).
jordan: Merged and triggered rollback pipeline: pipeline url: https://ci.company/internal/pipelines/rollback-9123
maria (oncall): Rolling back canary now — monitoring p99...
lee: Running the smoke suite against canary endpoints (smoke.sh)
lee: smoke.sh output: all checks ok, 200/200  lat p50 40ms p99 120ms
maria (oncall): Canary p99 down to 130ms, looks promising. Proceeding to full prod rollback in 2m.
jordan: Executed prod rollback at 1976543268. I'll watch traces and error rates.
maria (oncall): Prod p99 dropping to ~125ms within 2m, error rate unchanged. Nice work.
olga: Filing follow-up ticket to revert the connpool change more safely: TICKET-2984.
aj: I'll schedule a short infra sync to propose a staged config roll where we ramp conn limits with a circuit breaker.
jordan: Closing incident INC-2026-324 as mitigated; monitoring for 30m.
maria (oncall): Thanks everyone — huge help. :tada: If anything regresses I'll ping here.
deploy-bot: Incident INC-2026-324 status -> mitigated (author: jordan)
